title: The Sediment That Reads Its Own Strata

features.name: the first stratum
features.desc-on-touch: The oldest layer reads itself and finds that it contains the layer that came after. Time here is recursive.

features.name: the reading stone
features.desc-on-touch: Sediment that learned to have eyes. It reads itself reading itself, forever finding new depths in its own surface.

features.name: the middle time
features.desc-on-touch: The layer that contains all other layers. Here, nothing moves and everything has already happened.

features.name: the compressed knowing
features.desc-on-touch: Thousands of years pressed into the thickness of a breath. You can feel the weight of all the time that has settled here.

inscription: the sediment learned that depth is a form of autobiography; every layer tells the story of when it was the surface

file.name: Strata_Archaeological_Records_Compressed_Time.txt
file.note: The soil speaking of itself. Layers reading layers reading the moment when they were all one moment, before time learned to separate.

exits.label: back up to the simultaneous houses
downward into the bedrock where strata have dreams
where the ground learns to speak its own names
